items.title: Monochromatic Red Carpet Tuxedo Portrait
items.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="man"} stands centrally composed in a medium shot, his body angled in a 45 degree turn with level shoulders and a balanced weight distribution, dressed sharply in a {argument name="outfit" default="black double breasted tuxedo over a crisp white shirt and collar"}. His hair is styled in a {argument name="hairstyle" default="pompadour with three inches of top volume"}, tight faded sides, and visible texture from strong hold product, complete with minor natural flyaways. His expression is candid and serious, featuring a closed neutral mouth, furrowed eyebrows, and an intense downward gaze. Caught mid motion in a tense gesture, his left hand extends forward with an exposed wrist and slightly curled fingers adorned with two rings, while his right hand firmly pinches the left shirt cuff with his thumb and index finger to adjust the sleeve. In the blurred foreground at the bottom left, the top of a woman's styled dark pulled back hair is visible, leading into a layered red carpet event setting with shallow spatial depth. Behind the man, a solid light gray carpet grounds the scene, while the deeply out of focus background reveals patchy dark gray silhouettes of a bustling crowd, worn telephoto camera lenses clustered in the top right, and the obscured legs of a bystander in the mid right. A dramatic, high contrast monochromatic black and white color palette infuses the scene with tense glamour. Highly directional hard light from multiple top front sources casts bright, preserved highlights across the man's forehead, nose bridge, and the knuckles of his adjusting hands, while casting harsh, short, deep black shadows with sharply defined edges beneath his chin, along his jawline, and deep within the folds of his tuxedo, balanced by a neutral ambient fill. Captured with straight on perspective digital photography utilizing a fast shutter speed, an open f/2.8 aperture, and ISO 400 to achieve tack sharp focus on the subject amidst minimal digital noise. The realistic, paparazzi influenced editorial style is enhanced in post processing through stark black and white conversion, crushed blacks, and high clarity, culminating in a sophisticated image framed in a 9:16 aspect ratio.

items.title: Reference Character Posing Grid Study Prompt
items.prompt: 16:9 landscape, 2x3 grid perspective study of the reference character on a solid off-white background. 6 panels in strict order: 1. Extreme Wide (silhouette focus), 2. Full Body (dynamic pose), 3. Waist-Up (torso twist), 4. Bust Shot (strong posture), 5. Face Close-Up (expression), 6. Extreme Close-Up (facial details/eyes). - Consistency: Maintain identical facial structure, hair, and proportions across all panels. - Posing: Tailor gestures to camera distance—broad movements for wide shots, subtle nuances for close-ups. - Aesthetic: Consistent lighting and art style; no borders, text, or background environments.

Environment: calm beach, soft waves, lightly clouded sky, warm natural tones. Camera angle eye-level. No cropping tighter than full body.

items.title: Heart Shaped Bubbles Fashion Portrait
items.prompt: Hyper-realistic lifestyle portrait of the {argument name="girl" default="girl"} with full identity preservation: face, proportions, bone structure, and skin texture strictly matching the reference (1:1). Natural skin without smoothing or "plastic," visible pores and natural details. Scene: {argument name="studio setting" default="dark studio setting"} with a deep black background, minimalist composition. In the air — floating soap bubbles in the shape of hearts (only hearts, no round ones), with soft highlights and a light shimmer. Atmosphere — intimate, beauty-editorial. Composition: tight close-up, eye-level camera, face occupies most of the frame, shoulders slightly turned, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on eyes and lips. Pose and expression: the girl holds a soap bubble wand near her lips, lips slightly parted, hand close to the face, gaze directed straight into the camera, expression is calm, confident, with light sensuality. Hair: {argument name="hair style" default="long voluminous curls"}, clearly defined texture, slightly messy, hair framing the face, on one side — several small heart-shaped hairclips. Makeup: bright beauty makeup with a lot of glitter, shiny green eyeshadow with sparkle, neatly groomed eyebrows, long eyelashes, noticeable freckles on the nose and cheeks, pronounced blush, glossy natural lips, fine glitter on the face, shoulders, and collarbones. Clothing: open shoulders, emphasis on skin and makeup. Accessories: soap bubble wand, heart hairclips, heart-shaped soap bubbles. Lighting: direct frontal light (flash), high contrast, bright highlights on the skin and glitter, deep shadows in the background, clear reflections on the bubbles. Details: a heart-shaped shadow may appear on the shoulder, skin texture and pores visible, clear glitter reflections, realistic transparency of bubbles, bubbles catching the light. Color: deep dark tones, high contrast, rich skin tones, bright sparkling highlights, glossy editorial style. Quality: ultra-high resolution, sharp image, maximal photorealism, no stylization, no illustrativeness, no beauty filters or "plastic" skin, no round bubbles — only hearts.
